batch_goal: Finish the last reversible piece of the paint-zoom navigation loop in the web client: explicit, mobile-reachable zoom controls (zoom in / zoom out / fit-to-wall) that drive the existing single camera transform, so a player on a 390px phone can reach a comfortably targetable cell without pinch precision, and can always snap back to the whole wall. Web source and CSS only; no contract, no metadata, no tests-of-chain behaviour.
